17.1.old: The reserve path is open: the reserve is the first free alternate (hydrogen in the usual debate), and the database function odv1_record_panel_substitution holds a seat list that names no alternate seat, so a reserve substitution would be refused there; no run has reached it.
17.1.new: The reserve path: the reserve is drawn as §10 gives, and the recorder odv1_record_panel_substitution accepts only the seats of its own list (§10); a reserve substitution is not shown by a run.
